verdict.rationale: Checkout.com ships SDKs, mobile SDKs, and a hosted MCP server, any of which could collect telemetry, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains nothing about telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The 'advanced analytics' pricing mention refers to merchant transaction insights, not user tracking controls, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
